entities.summary: Roger Craig Smith is an American voice actor. He is known for his voice roles in video games such as Chris Redfield in the Resident Evil series (2009–2017), Ezio Auditore da Firenze in the Assassin's Creed series (2009–2011), Kyle Crane in Dying Light (2015) as well as in Dying Light: The Beast (2025), Sonic the Hedgehog, E-123 Omega, and the Wisp Announcer in the Sonic the Hedgehog series (2010–present), and Mirage in Apex Legends. In addition, he has voiced Captain America in several Marvel projects, and Batman in Batman: Arkham Origins (2013), Batman: Arkham Shadow (2024), and several other DC projects featuring the character.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prolific voice actor in video games and other media, Roger Craig Smith has had a significant impact on popular culture, particularly in the gaming industry. His roles have contributed to the success of various franchises, including Resident Evil, Assassin's Creed, and Sonic the Hedgehog.
